rows.expectedText: Virtual trading can still involve real feelings, but the fictional balance does not expose the learner’s savings to market losses. That difference limits what a practice result can establish about decisions under real financial pressure. Use the exercise to check order mechanics and the cash ledger, rather than to certify emotional resilience. In a written debrief, describe what you actually observed and which circumstances the simulator left out. A confident practice decision or a completed worksheet does not demonstrate that the same response would occur when real money is at risk.

scope: One narrow mobile visual recheck after declining optional analytics in an isolated guest context. Paragraph scrolled into view; no analytics opt-in or account publication.
